g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the reward before the optional game. The decline and ad-failure paths leave the user able to continue without losing the offer.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is three in-app Advanced reasoning mode answers, not cash or a transferable benefit.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger uses time since the last session and subscription status, not chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposed mechanics do not remove or cap a free feature; the decline path says home works as before. The unsupported chat-loss statement in the offer copy is assessed under c2.

g_brand_safety.reason: The placement is a card on the Chats home screen, which s01 rates safe, rather than inside a conversation.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The reward samples Advanced reasoning mode, which the Luzia+ paywall lists as a paid benefit at s02.e03.

c2_evidence.reason: The offer copy claims all past chats will be lost in 30 days without an upgrade. No product-model element supports that chat-retention or upgrade rule.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is limited to three answers and expires at midnight, rather than granting lasting access to the paid feature.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger places a dismissible card on Chats home at app open, before the user starts a task.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The flow uses a sponsored game triggered by a detectable app-open event, and the ad-failure path withholds the reward when play is not confirmed.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the Chats home placement, Luzia+ badge, and Advanced reasoning mode paywall benefit.
